_about: pricing-pages, Stage B (20 October 2026, docs/pricing-pages-report.md): the message keys Stage B REMOVED (with their text before), REWORDED (before → after) and ADDED (with their text), per locale — the sibling of scripts/fixtures/plans-stage-a-messages.json and plans-stage-a2-messages.json, same shape. scripts/_lp2-frozen.cjs `stageA()` returns the three files merged in order (Stage A, A2, then B; a key reworded twice keeps its FIRST before and its LAST after), so every reader of the plan stages’ recorded message changes — the opt-in as-moved overlay and the language-phase key checks — reads B’s too. Written from the working tree vs git HEAD c6c44c9e, limited to Stage B’s keys (planFeatures, featuresPage, planMeta, pricing, planTable, landing.pricing, compare’s fee-shape lines, the van modal body, the trial popup offer / body, Billing’s notStarted body, the first-load failure line, the welcome email’s trial line); never recaptured.
